name: Tiny Waterloo
comment: Single source of truth for the map frame. Read by pipeline (Python), reference renderer (three.js) and the web viewer.

origin.comment: Local ENU origin (canvas 0,0 at z=0): centre of the UW main-campus landmark cluster (SLC, MC, EIT, E5/E7, Dana Porter) so the first 2x2 tile patch frames it.

projection.comment: Local tangent plane: transverse Mercator (UTM-like) centred on origin, metres. x=east, y=north, z=up (z relative to datum_m above sea level).

camera.comment: Fixed orthographic oblique camera. heading_deg = compass bearing the camera looks toward (horizontal), pitch_deg = downward tilt. Axes are derived and stored explicitly by pipeline/world.py; never re-derive from angles elsewhere.

sun.comment: Direction TOWARD the sun. Late-summer mid-afternoon in Waterloo, from the south-west so shadows fall north-east (up-right on screen).

heights.comment: Lossless PNG. encoded = 256*R + G ; height_m = encoded / units_per_m + floor_m ; valid = B > 127. height is z (metres relative to datum_m).

art_finish.comment: Deterministic pixel-art finish applied at publish time to accepted generated art (art/accepted keeps the original). Box-downscale to work_px, light unsharp mask, median-cut palette of `colors` without dithering, nearest-neighbour upscale to frame_px.
